verse: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
story: Jeremiah's lament is full of ruin, and then, in the middle of it, one steady sentence about goodness.

The writer has described pain in plain and bitter terms. But he chooses to call to mind the LORD's steadfast love and unfailing mercies, and from that ground he draws a quiet conclusion: God is good to those who wait for Him and to the soul that seeks Him. Waiting here is not wasted time. It is the posture in which people meet a God who draws near and says, do not be afraid.
Seeking is itself a kind of answer. Wait on Him today, even if all you can offer is a tired and open hand.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
